Post gives the bodily change an explicit disease label or links it to a specific condition. Code only explicit labels; do not infer.
Post describes symptom onset, duration, development, recurrence, or timing. Code only for symptom/bodily change timing — not appointment or result dates.
Post expresses emotions generated by the symptom or health threat (fear, panic, anxiety, dread). Distinct from descriptions of functional impact.
Uses symptom severity, pain, hardness, texture, or physical quality to judge seriousness.
Uses symptom persistence, duration, or change over time to evaluate seriousness.

Asks others to interpret the meaning or significance of a bodily change or a finding described in clinical-report language.
Asks explicitly whether the symptom is concerning or requires medical care. Code 1 only when OP explicitly asks; do not infer from anxious tone. NA if not applicable.
The post explicitly seeks emotional relief, validation, reassurance, or an outlet for fear, anxiety, panic, or distress. Emotional expression alone does not qualify.
Shares an update, timeline, result, or experience that may inform others.
Asks about testing procedures, appointments, access to results, or subsequent steps in care.
Provides specific objective medical, procedural, or care-navigation information. General encouragement, vague reassurance, or personal experience alone do not qualify.
Includes empathy, comfort, encouragement, validation, or “you are not alone” support.
Explicitly encourages the user to see a medical professional.
Suggests the symptom is likely benign or not something to panic about.
Provides information through the commenter’s own comparable experience.
